Hi,

One of our outposts at [Location] is in need of some light repairs. The folks onsite have estimated that you’ll need three fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to fix up to three or so pipes.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks again for your help,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
